Wear differs by equipment profile; heater and filter do not receive the same hourly deduction
Arbitrary elapsed-time partitions agree without repeatedly sampling failure chance
Repeated and overlapping intervals cannot apply wear or emit the same failure twice
Storage and disabled devices do not operate or suffer powered wear
Lighting wear follows the actual saved daily schedule and never ages an Off fixture
Cleaning restores maintenance/efficiency without resetting condition, component wear, age or filter bacteria
Neglect increases integrated failure risk and reduces flow gradually before malfunction
Temporary malfunction and repair-required states stop only their physical device
Component repair preserves identity, tracked age, physical chassis condition and valid purchase receipts
Permanent failure is probabilistic, not zero-condition expiration; cleaning cannot resurrect it
Maintenance fees reuse the established 30% catalog/rating coefficient; purchases and rewards are unchanged
Rendering 30 or 120 frames cannot age equipment or sample a new failure
Private reliability RNG never advances biological, breeding or store random streams
Freshwater equipment keeps its previous wear and capacity model
Full save/load retains thresholds, histories, item identity and the exact reliability state
Unknown schema or corrupted failure thresholds reject rather than rerolling old devices
Install/remove transfers retain the same condition, age, maintenance and private failure thresholds
